task.title: To delete a smart field, smart clause or repeat section

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and launch the add-in.
Log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced and open the Agreement Document.
Select the smart element in the document. Highlight the text value of the field, clause, section or table using your mouse.
Press Delete or Backspace. This only deletes the field value but the content border remains.
Press Delete or Backspace again to completely delete the smart element. Now, the content border is also deleted.

ol.li: Identify the smart element in the document.
Click the Vertical Ellipsis icon on the content control border of the element.

postreq.p: The content control border of the fields and the field value, will be deleted.
